messages.subject: Online Tutorials for DISTANCE software
parts:
Dear Distance Samplers,

Does anyone know if there are online tutorials that demonstrate how to use =
DISTANCE software?

I am aware of only one video that shows how to import data from an ASCII fi=
le into DISTANCE to perform an analysis (http://screencast-o-matic.com/watc=
h/cljnDBKAB).

I am starting out with DISTANCE and videos on the following topics would he=
lp me out greatly:

1. How to perform exploratory data analysis. What are the key things to loo=
k out for. What strategies can be employed if data are not ideal (e.g. spik=
e at zero, rounding to favoured distances, etc.).
2. Model selection. What each of the different models means.
3. How do you interpret the DISTANCE results. What are the keys things to l=
ook out for.

I have read the DISTANCE manual and various other references, so please don=
't think I'm being lazy. I just find I learn best if written material is co=
mplemented by visual demonstrations.

Please email me directly at Andrew...@australianwildlife.org. I will co=
llate any answers I receive and post a summary of what I find out.

Thanks for your time.

Sincerely,
Andrew Carter
